key.name: backend-path
key.summary: Path to the codexbar CLI executable.
key.description: Leave empty to resolve the 'codexbar' CLI from $PATH.

key.name: default-provider
key.summary: Provider shown by default in the top bar.
key.description: Providers are detected from codexbar CLI output; set this with gsettings to prefer a provider id.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: The extension polls the backend on this interval.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Whether to show the remaining percentage in the top bar.
key.description: When disabled, only the icon remains visible in the panel.

key.name: keep-last-good-value
key.summary: Keep the last successful value when refresh fails.
key.description: If disabled, the panel clears its data whenever the backend errors.
